findings.source_evidence: The source gives a source-specific explanation of convergence in distribution within the CLT context.

rationale: The target accurately captures the literal unrestricted pointwise CDF criterion, including quantification over every threshold and the absence of a continuity-point clause. It is nevertheless not semantically equivalent to the supplied source contract: the normalized sums, natural-number limit, and standard-normal law are replaced by arbitrary data, and the theorem is merely an unfolding of that generalized definition. Both implication directions therefore fail at the level of the complete statements, so the classification is not-faithful-different.
